text: Enforce at ask, not the tables: inside a boundary ask answers from the bundle and throws for a var without a record or a field the record lacks; atom tables bound to nil as backup; lowering writes to the entry's own accumulator. Var-metadata reads (6105408) become record/context fields; the lint grows to flag meta on vars and resolve. Compiler code: one hash over lower-wasm, lower-llvm*, lw-rt, lw-ext in the compiler key (no per-fn ran! tracing). Check mode stays as a gate row, now catching reads that bypass the boundary.
author: claude
